component.name: Clara
component.summary: Modular audio plugin host and modernized patchbay

description.p: Clara (Carla Improved) is a modular audio plugin host and a modernized, node-based patchbay. It loads LV2, VST2, VST3, AU and native plugins, routes audio and MIDI, and lets you organise everything on an infinite canvas with colour-coded cables, animated signal flow and powerful auto-arrange and routing algorithms.
First Clara feature release: patchbay overhaul, animated signal flow, Catppuccin theming and portable AppImage/Flatpak packaging.
